items.title: Microsoft OneDrive Auto-Sync Exposes Enterprise Secrets in SharePoint Online
items.description: A default auto-sync feature in Microsoft OneDrive automatically moves local files to SharePoint, creating a significant security risk by exposing sensitive data and secrets on a large scale.
